steps.label: Compliance & redundancy
steps.sub: sovereignty requirements, or deliberately avoiding one vendor's full control

code:
native database replication   -- e.g. Postgres logical replication
change data capture (CDC)     -- Debezium, AWS DMS, ADF change-tracking
cloud-native global features   -- Cosmos DB multi-region, DynamoDB Global Tables

avoid: dual-writing from the application layer --
       a partial failure leaves copies silently inconsistent
caption: CDC reads the transaction log and streams changes -- it doesn't touch the live tables directly.

code:
last-writer-wins (LWW)     -- Cosmos DB / DynamoDB Global Tables default
application-level merge     -- custom logic combines both versions
CRDTs                        -- counters/sets merge deterministically
single-writer-per-partition -- simplest fix: avoid the conflict entirely
caption: Eventual consistency is the realistic default -- the real skill is choosing how conflicts resolve.
